Keswick Systems Expands With New Regional Center
By Gwen Hollister, Wexbury — March 12
Keswick Systems, the software company based in Wexbury, announced this week that it will open a new regional service center aimed at supporting its rapidly growing customer base throughout the Hadleigh market. --[1]--.
The facility will occupy several floors of the Trelane Complex in Tarnwick, roughly an hour's drive south of the company's main offices, and will handle technical support and account services for the entire region. --[2]--. "Placing a team closer to our clients allows us to respond to their needs far more quickly," said Gerald Thornbury, the company's chief operations officer, who has overseen the project since it began.
According to the company, the center is expected to create about sixty new positions during its first year of operation. --[3]--. Hiring will proceed in stages, with the first group of employees starting during the first quarter of next year and additional staff added by the third quarter. Renovation work at the building is expected to be finished shortly before the first employees arrive. --[4]--.

Hawthorn Apartments - Resident Handbook: Shared Facilities
Revised May 2
Residents may reserve the service elevator, the meeting room, and the roof terrace at no charge, and each reservation of any facility lasts two hours. Written requests must reach the management office five days ahead, and each apartment may hold one reservation per week.
Of the three facilities, the service elevator is the one residents reserve for a move, and the rules that follow apply to those reservations only. Before each one, building staff pad the elevator walls and lay floor covers between the entrance and the elevator, but they do not carry or pack belongings.
On the day of the move, furniture and large cartons may be taken through the basement loading door, which is staffed on weekdays only, so on a weekend reservation every item must pass through the main lobby. As for the elevator itself, the attendant on duty unlocks it for the first reservation of the day, while residents with a later reservation collect the elevator key at the management office counter.
